archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) crossed with Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast)
design_philosophy: Ultra premium, modern futuristic. We avoid standard SaaS templates by employing extreme contrast, precise typography, bento-grid asymmetry, and high-fidelity 3D assets.

surfaces_and_effects.tracing_beam_card: relative overflow-hidden bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.05)] border border-white/10 hover:border-[#06B6D4]/50 transition-colors duration-500
surfaces_and_effects.button_primary: bg-[#F8FAFC] text-[#071120] hover:bg-[#06B6D4] hover:text-white transition-all duration-300 font-bold px-8 py-4 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(6,182,212,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(6,182,212,0.6)]

hero_3d_abstract.description: 3D futuristic glass sculpture floating with cyan and purple glowing core.
hero_3d_abstract.usage: Hero section background or right-aligned visual to balance the dark UI.

portfolio_mockup_saas.description: Premium dark mode dashboard UI mockup.
portfolio_mockup_saas.usage: Featured image in the Portfolio section.

portfolio_mockup_ecommerce.usage: Featured image in the Portfolio section.

sections.name: Navigation
sections.instructions: Sticky at top. Use glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl`). Include ITcrista infoX text logo, links (Home, Services, Portfolio, About, Contact), and a prominent 'Get in Touch' button. Ensure mobile hamburger menu functions correctly and links are accessible.

sections.name: Hero
sections.instructions: Dark mode #071120. Extreme asymmetry. Left: Massive text 'Next-Gen IT Agency', dual CTAs. Right: Implement `hero_3d_abstract` image floating with `framer-motion` vertical drift. Background needs heavy, blurred cyan/purple radial gradients to simulate glow. Include animated counters below the CTAs.

sections.name: Trusted By
sections.instructions: Use a subtle seamless marquee (`react-fast-marquee`) for company logos. Apply opacity-50 and grayscale to logos, hovering to full opacity. Maintain dark background.

sections.name: Services
sections.instructions: Bento Grid layout on desktop. On mobile, this MUST be a horizontal slider (using CSS scroll-snap or Swiper). Dark cards with 1px border. On hover, apply glowing `Tracing Beam` effect using the accent colors. Include 13 distinct IT/Ecom services.

sections.name: Why Choose Us
sections.instructions: INTERSTITIAL: Switch to Light Theme (#F8FAFC) to create massive contrast and reset user attention. Dark text (#0A0F1A). Grid of feature blocks with large typography and minimal icons.

sections.name: Portfolio
sections.instructions: Back to Dark Mode. Filterable grid (Ecom, SaaS, Website). Use the generated portfolio mockups. Cards must have a high-end glass hover effect that reveals the case study CTA.

sections.name: Development Process
sections.instructions: Light theme. A vertical timeline or horizontal scrolling stepper showing the 6 steps (Discovery, Design, Development, Testing, Launch, Support). Minimalist Swiss-style numbers.

sections.name: Testimonials
sections.instructions: Dark mode. A slick mobile-responsive slider for testimonials using the provided avatar images. Quotes in large, expressive serif or clean sans-serif.

sections.name: Technologies
sections.instructions: Dark theme. 'Technologies We Master'. Grid or marquee of stacked logos (Shopify, WordPress, React, Next.js, Node.js, Laravel, WooCommerce, Magento).

sections.name: Pricing Preview
sections.instructions: Dark theme. 3 pricing tiers. Highlight the middle tier with the glowing cyan/purple gradient border. Large price numbers.

sections.name: FAQ
sections.instructions: Dark theme. Use Shadcn Accordion component but styled aggressively. 1px borders, white text, no background.

sections.name: Final CTA & Footer
sections.instructions: Dark theme. Massive typography CTA: 'Let's Build the Future'. Form section. The footer must have huge py-32 padding. A massive 'ITcrista infoX' text at the very bottom.

libraries: react-fast-marquee (for Trusted By and Tech Stacks)
technical_rules.components: Do not build raw selects or datepickers. Rely on customized Shadcn primitives where needed, but use raw HTML/Tailwind for marketing grid bento cards.
technical_rules.testing: All interactive elements, buttons, and form inputs MUST include `data-testid` (e.g., `data-testid='hero-cta-button'`).
technical_rules.mobile: Images max height 80vh on mobile. Any section with >6 cards MUST be a horizontal slider to feel native-app quality.
